notes.title: Version 1.0.23 Update
notes.notes: Hey all!  This build provides new puzzles, and fixes some freezing issues and large save issues.  Thanks so much for playing, and reach out to us at support@playknotwords.com if you have any issues!

notes.title: Version 1.0.10
notes.notes: Hi all!  This update comes with a few minor bugfixes, as well as new puzzles and an updated wordlist.  Thank you all so much for sticking with Knotwords, and we hope you continue to enjoy it!

notes.title: Version 1.0.9 Update
notes.notes: Hope you've all been enjoying the new share feature!  This update fixes an issue with the in-game statistics not correctly counting how many times you've shared a puzzle, and the default puzzle name on sharing.  It also has some minor puzzle fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.0.8
notes.notes:
Hope you've been enjoying Knotwords! We've made a lot of updates, big and small.

The biggest thing you may notice is a new Share feature - try it out!

If you play with "correct" word feedback, a big new change is that we no longer allow alternative solutions - so it will only consider "correct" the original permutation we created.

We've also made a lot of stability updates behind the scenes, and fixed some lingering issues with Achievements. You can also turn off the updates about streaks if you want in the settings menu.

As always, if there are any issues, let us know at support@playknotwords.com.

notes.title: Update Notes for Version 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!  Thanks so much for sticking with Knotwords, this is a quick quality of life update while we work on more fixes and features!  Some of the fixes:


 Fixed delete in word mode if you enter something in-line with what you’re deleting
 Fixed infrequent crash on game over
 Add arrows to monthly calendar
 Remove pop-up from clicking numbers in twist puzzles
 Fixed a few other input bugs
 Other small bugs


As always, reach out at support@playknotwords.com if you have any support questions - I got a bit behind on emails while sick the last few weeks, but if your support email fell through the cracks feel free to reach out again!

- Jack

notes.title: Version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Thanks so much for sticking with Knotwords!  We've got a lot of fixes in this version, including:


 Daily Mini streaks should be fixed and fixed retroactively.
 Puzzlebook achievement bug should be fixed and fixed retroactively
 Option to halt the background in global settings.
 Other small bugfixes.


As always, let us know if you're having any issues at support@playknotwords.com.

notes.title: Version 1.0.5 Update!
notes.notes:
New mode: Daily Minis 
We added a new (free!) daily mode that's a fixed small size throughout the week. We hope you enjoy it!

Other adjustments:
- Modified how selection with arrow keys works (use tab to switch typing direction)
- Fix for 'Correct' feedback mode not giving any feedback at all on 2 and 3 letter words
- Fixed a typo in a mode description
- Fixed a statistics bug with incorrect average time on dailies

notes.title: Patch Notes for May 2, 2022
notes.notes: Hi!  We fixed a few outstanding bugs, but if you find any more be sure to let us know at support@playknotwords.com.

notes.title: Update Notes April 30, 2022
notes.notes:
Hey all!  Thanks so much for sticking with Knotwords - we've got some fixes out, including a crash on load if you've completed a puzzlebook, and a hang on category puzzles.

If you run into any more bugs, definitely let us know at support@playknotwords.com.
